'''Mount Avilatan''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] located on the island of [[Avilatan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. A [[Separatist stronghold]] used by the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] was situated in the very heart of the volcano.
